method: Manual full-response/context reading, then mechanical binding of chosen spans and descriptive counts. No automatic quality or scientific verdict.

continuity.limit: Integrity may pass for a valid partial or unstarted export. Saved text, applied feedback, supplied prior text and appropriate prose use are separate outcomes.
